newsitem.title: JAPAN: Fuji Bank says Tobishima forms restructuring plan.
newsitem.headline: Fuji Bank says Tobishima forms restructuring plan.

text.p: Fuji Bank Ltd said on Friday that general contractor Tobishima Corp was forming a new restructuring plan.

"We heard that the company is forming a new restructuring plan," a Fuji spokesman said. But he said Fuji, one of the banks with which Tobishima has close business ties, did not know anything more than that.
The economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimnbun said on Friday that Fuji and Tobishima, which is burdened by property-related debts, had agreed on a new restructuring plan for Tobishima.
A Tobishima spokesman said he was surprised at the newspaper report and Tobishima officials were at the Tokyo Stock Exchange to clarify the report.
"We cannot make any comment on the report at the moment," he said.

The Nihon Keizai said the new plan agreed with Fuji proposed that creditor financial institutions should not hold Tobishima responsible for bad debts worth about 650 billion yen which it transferred to one of its units under a previous restructuring programme.
Under the 1992 restructuring plan, Tobishima had guaranteed the debts, the newspaper said.
Also under the new restructuring programme, Tobishima will ask creditor institutions to further cut interest rates on its debts, the paper said.
There are more than 30 creditor institutions including Fuji, the paper said. It said Tobishima will announce its new plan on Friday.
